content: Moderation-loop anti-patterns: endless rejection loops from resubmitting without understanding the rejection; velocity/behavioural signals (rapid create-delete, repeated same-day edits, parallel submissions) are what marketplaces actually rate-limit rather than raw counts; guidance is to resubmit only the corrected item and wait for processing. Separately, under DSA Art.17 every restriction now requires a statement of reasons delivered to the affected user (in-product or email) naming the specific ground - a silent state change is not just bad UX.
